messages:
Sara: Quick sync — ACME POC just asked for SIG/CAIQ, our DPA/SCCs, and a clear DSAR/data-deletion runbook. Also asked pricing for Dedicated proof-of-concept. Can we assemble by EOD tomorrow? @Devon @Nina @Oliver
Devon: On it. I can assemble SIG and CAIQ. Do we have the latest CAIQ export from last quarter? :thinking:
Nina: I have DPA_redline_v2 from Legal. Key deletion clause they want: "Customer Data will be deleted on termination and upon verified DSAR subject request within 30 days; backups purged within 90 days." Legal prefers 'reasonable efforts' in one spot — will attach notes.
Oliver: For the Dedicated POC: infra estimate rough: $6k/mo for 4xA100 equiv + network. We can do a 30% POC discount for first month. We can enable auto-delete policy (30d) for tenant data; backups still 90d purge. Need confirmation on residency (they're EU).
Ryan: Security check: ACME asked about KMS/HSM, audit log retention, and MFAs for admin. We support BYOK for Private and customer-managed keys for Dedicated; HSM via partner. I'll map controls to CAIQ entries.
Sara: They also want list of subprocessors and SCCs confirmation. Customer legal asked for 90-day logs retention and the DSAR flow — they might escalate the 'penalty' clause request as a blocker.
Devon: Uploading current SIG answers and CAIQ snapshot to drive: https://redwood.internal/share/1832/sig-caiq.zip :point_up:
Nina: DSAR runbook (short):
```
1) Receive request -> verify identity
2) Pull user data via tenant export (ID)
3) If delete requested: mark for deletion, notify dependent services
4) Execute deletion; record audit event
5) Confirm to requester within 30 days
6) Start backup purge lifecycle (complete within 90 days)
``` 
Legal notes: we keep 'reasonable efforts' on backup purge timeline.
Oliver: Tech confirm: export + delete is automated for Hosted and Dedicated; for Private customers we provide the runbook and tools. We can attach sample scripts. Also need to ensure can rotate keys without losing access to cached encrypted blobs.
Ryan: I'll produce a control mapping matrix: CAIQ -> SOC2 -> our controls. Also capture KMS/HSM posture and retention policies.
Sara: Enterprise blocker: ACME's counsel is pushing for contract-level fines for 'data leakage'. Legal flagged as high risk — anyone seen precedent we can use to push back?
Nina: Precedent: we typically offer indemnity for breaches due to our negligence; contractual fines are rare. We can offer higher SLA credits but avoid fixed fines. Will prepare talking points.
Devon: Plan: I'll package SIG, CAIQ, DPA redline, DSAR runbook, pricing sheet for Dedicated POC (incl discount) and send to ACME legal. Expect draft email by EOD. @Sara do you want to own customer comms?
Sara: I will cc and do intro. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Vault upload complete: /vault/ACME/sig_caiq_dpa_183210.zip (access: devon,nina,sara,ryan,oliver)
Oliver: I'll follow up with a short pricing spreadsheet and the infra cost breakdown before EOD.
Devon: Sending now — attaching bundle. Will mark as owner for delivery. Closing this thread after ACME ack.
